blocks.text: The same grid at a monospace cell's aspect gives 160 columns by 23 lines, with one @ per printed cell, 1,427 in all. It is solid at the left and dithers away to the right. The plain text version goes into a code block or the CLI banner.
Each line of the SVG is set to a fixed length, so any monospace face draws the same picture. Shown at 1320 px wide, which puts the characters at about 14 px.

body.alt: The bar monogram as at signs, solid at the left and dithering away to the right
